brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Madalena association in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus.
brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of Madalena Association in the Treatment of Type II Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: National, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Triple-dummy, Phase III Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Madalena Association in the Treatment of Type II Diabetes Mellitus.

primary_outcomes.measure: Change from baseline in glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) levels.
